name: Lagos Nights
summary: Warm, glossy city nights: rooftops, danfo lights, fashion-forward friends, easy swagger and romance.
camera: Smooth gimbal glides and slow push-ins; low angles for swagger; wide rooftop establishing shots.
light: Warm practicals, neon signage, sodium streetlight, soft golden skin light.
editing: Cuts on the kick; hold the romantic beats longer.
movement: Relaxed grooves, shoulder bounces, group dance breaks on the hook.
design: Contemporary Lagos fashion, ankara accents, busy markets, rooftops, bridges.
respect: Show a real, modern city; credit local stylists and dancers where you can.

name: Nollywood Melodrama
summary: Heightened family drama told in close faces, reaction shots and big emotional turns.
camera: Frontal mediums and close-ups, reaction inserts, occasional dramatic zoom.
light: Bright domestic interiors; hard window light for confrontations.
editing: Beat-by-beat reaction cutting; pauses before revelations.
movement: Little dance; gestures and confrontations carry the scenes.
design: Living rooms, church halls, family compounds, wax-print dress.
respect: Played sincerely, not as parody.

name: Sahel Golden Hour
summary: Wide, patient frames of earth, wind and light; people small in vast landscapes; music as meditation.
camera: Locked-off wides, slow lateral tracks, long takes.
light: Low golden sun, dust haze, deep blue dusk.
editing: Long holds, few cuts, cut on phrase endings.
movement: Walking, weaving, hands at work; stillness.
design: Adobe architecture, indigo cloth, open desert.
respect: Name real places; avoid sacred sites and ceremonies without permission.

name: Amapiano House Party
summary: Township-to-club energy: log-drum drops, dance crews, sneakers, crowds that move as one.
camera: Handheld in the crowd, overhead dance formations, wide-angle close to dancers.
light: Coloured party lights, strobes on drops, warm dusk outside.
editing: Cut to the log drum; freeze or speed-ramp on the drop.
movement: Signature amapiano steps, crew formations, call-and-response dancing.
design: Street fashion, bucket hats, yard parties, taverns.
respect: Use real dance vocabulary; credit choreographers.

name: Afrofuturist Epic
summary: Myth and technology fused: regal figures, sculptural costume, futuristic cities grown from tradition.
camera: Hero low angles, symmetrical compositions, sweeping crane moves.
light: Rim-lit silhouettes, bioluminescent accents, gold highlights.
editing: Grand reveals on the downbeat; tableau holds.
movement: Ceremonial processions, powerful poses, synchronised movement.
design: Sculptural armour, adinkra-like geometry (invented, not copied), floating architecture.
respect: Invent symbols rather than borrowing sacred ones.

name: Cairo Golden Age
summary: Black-and-white elegance of mid-century Egyptian film: grand staircases, orchestras, longing looks.
camera: Graceful dolly moves, soft close-ups, staged two-shots.
light: Glamour key light, soft halation, deep shadows.
editing: Classical continuity, dissolve-like pacing.
movement: Elegant gestures, waltz-like couples, orchestra performance.
design: Art-deco salons, Nile balconies, tailored suits and gowns.
respect: Reference the era's real stars and craft respectfully.

name: Bollywood Spectacle
summary: The song as a dream: costume changes, sweeping locations, big group choreography and star close-ups.
camera: Crane sweeps, whip pans between locations, hero close-ups on the chorus.
light: Saturated, bright, sunlit; fairy lights at night.
editing: Location jumps on phrase changes; choreography on the beat.
movement: Large synchronised choreography, hand mudra-inspired flourishes, playful couple dance.
design: Lehengas and kurtas, palaces, mountain meadows, festival streets.
avoid: Using sacred festivals as backdrop decoration.
respect: Research the region and occasion each costume belongs to.

name: K-pop Concept Video
summary: Set-per-concept precision: sculpted sets, crisp formation dance, individual close-ups for each member.
camera: Precise dolly and crane moves, snap zooms, symmetrical formation wides.
light: Clean high-key sets, coloured gels per concept, glossy reflections.
editing: Hard cuts on every accent; point-choreography on the hook.
movement: Tight formation choreography with a signature 'point' move.
design: Concept sets (school, lab, candy, dystopia), coordinated styling.
avoid: Copying a real group's signature moves.
respect: Create original choreography.

name: Hong Kong Mood Piece
summary: Neon loneliness: step-printed motion, smoky corridors, lovers who never quite meet.
camera: Handheld step-print blur, tight doorframes, off-centre compositions.
light: Neon green and red, fluorescent corridors, rain reflections.
editing: Slow motion against normal speed; repeated moments.
movement: Smoking, waiting, walking past each other.
design: Narrow apartments, noodle bars, qipao and sharp suits.
respect: Treat the city as lived-in, not exotic.

name: Anime Opening
summary: Ninety seconds of promise: character line-ups, sky shots, speed-line runs and a title-card-worthy finale.
camera: Dynamic smears, pans across line-ups, sakuga action beats.
light: Bright skies, lens flares, dramatic sunset backlight.
editing: Cut on every beat in the verse; hold the hero shot on the hook.
movement: Running, jumping, wind in hair, action poses.
design: School rooftops, city skylines, stylised fantasy.
respect: Original characters and designs.

name: Pastoral Wonder
summary: Wind across fields, small kindnesses, food, flight and weather; wonder in ordinary life.
camera: Gentle pans, low grassy angles, sky-filled wides.
light: Soft daylight, cloud shadows, warm lamplight.
editing: Unhurried; let moments breathe.
movement: Everyday gestures, cycling, running through grass.
respect: Original world and creatures.

name: Wuxia Poetry
summary: Swordplay as dance: bamboo forests, flowing silk, colour-coded chapters and weightless motion.
camera: Wire-work arcs, slow motion, overhead choreographed wides.
light: Diffused forest light, colour-washed chapters.
editing: Rhythmic action beats, slow-motion peaks.
movement: Flowing martial choreography, leaps, fabric trails.
respect: Research the era's dress and architecture.

name: Tropical Dreamlike
summary: Jungle nights, spirits and memory drifting into each other; slow, hypnotic and gentle.
camera: Static wides, slow dollies into darkness.
light: Moonlight, fireflies, fluorescent tubes in the jungle.
editing: Long takes, time slips.
movement: Stillness, slow walking, sleeping figures.
respect: Treat local beliefs with seriousness.

name: French New Wave
summary: Jump cuts, street shooting, lovers talking in cafés and running through Paris; cool and free.
camera: Handheld street tracking, looks to camera, long walking takes.
light: Available light, overcast Paris grey, café interiors.
editing: Jump cuts, playful rule-breaking.
movement: Walking, running, spontaneous dancing in a café.
design: Striped tops, trench coats, cafés, bookshops.

name: Nordic Noir
summary: Cold light, empty landscapes and quiet dread; faces that hide more than they show.
camera: Slow drone wides, static interiors, long lenses.
light: Overcast daylight, blue hour, practical lamps.
editing: Slow, tense, cut on silence.
movement: Minimal; people alone in big spaces.
design: Concrete, pine forests, wool knits, minimal interiors.

name: Neorealist Streets
summary: Ordinary people, real streets, non-actors' faces; hardship and warmth side by side.
camera: Handheld at eye level, real locations, deep focus.
light: Natural daylight, black-and-white or muted colour.
editing: Plain, observational.
movement: Work, walking, family life.
respect: Dignity first.

name: UK Estates & Grime
summary: Crews on the block, fisheye close-ups, tracksuits and council-estate architecture.
camera: Fisheye close to lens, low-angle crew shots, tracking through walkways.
light: Flat daylight, sodium night, car headlights.
editing: Hard cuts on bars; stutter edits.
movement: Bar delivery to camera, crew energy, skanking.
respect: Work with the scene, not about it.

name: Constructivist Montage
summary: Collision editing, diagonals, machines and crowds; graphic, rhythmic and bold.
camera: Extreme low angles, diagonals, graphic close-ups.
light: High contrast, hard sun, deep blacks.
editing: Rhythmic montage: images collide on the beat.
movement: Marching crowds, machines, workers in rhythm.
respect: Keep it graphic, not political endorsement.

name: Flamenco Duende
summary: Heat, stamping heels, clapping circles and faces full of feeling in whitewashed courtyards.
camera: Low angles on feet, circling dollies, tight faces.
light: Hard sun and shadow; candlelit tablao at night.
editing: Cut on the palmas; hold the singer.
movement: Flamenco footwork, arms, clapping circles.
design: Courtyards, tablaos, ruffled dresses, fitted jackets.
respect: Flamenco is Gitano/Andalusian heritage; credit and consult artists.

name: Reggaetón Heat
summary: Beach-to-club heat: bright sun, flashy cars, perreo crowds and bold colour.
camera: Slow-motion hero walks, low angles, orbiting gimbal.
light: Tropical sun, neon night, coloured haze.
editing: Dembow rhythm cuts, speed ramps.
movement: Perreo, group dance, confident struts.
respect: Keep performers empowered and consenting.

name: Telenovela Gloss
summary: Glossy passion: mansions, secret letters, slaps and tears in soft focus.
camera: Slow push-ins to faces, dramatic zooms, over-shoulder confrontations.
light: Soft glamour light, candlelight, storms.
editing: Hold the reaction; cliffhanger freeze.
movement: Embraces, turns away, letters and rings.
respect: Heightened but sincere.

name: Carnaval Colour
summary: Streets exploding with colour, drums, feathers and friends dancing until sunrise.
camera: Handheld in parades, overhead drum lines, close-ups of joy.
light: Midday sun, festival lights at night.
editing: Drum-driven cutting, fast montage.
movement: Samba steps, passinho, parade formations.
design: Samba-school costume (as craft), favela hills, beaches.
respect: Credit samba schools and communities.

name: Magic Realism
summary: The impossible told plainly: butterflies from letters, the dead at the dinner table, rain that lasts for years.
camera: Calm, observational frames where wonders happen without comment.
light: Warm adobe interiors, marigold afternoons, candle nights.
editing: Unhurried; wonders appear in the cut.
movement: Daily life that bends into the fantastic.
avoid: Using Día de Muertos as mere decoration.
respect: Research the meaning of altars and rituals you show.

name: 90s Hip-Hop Video
summary: Fisheye lenses, stoops and block parties, crews and B-boys, film grain and swagger.
camera: Fisheye, low angle, handheld through the crowd.
light: Daylight on the block, club spotlights, film grain.
editing: Cut on the snare; scratch stutters.
movement: Head nods, B-boying, crew shots.
respect: Nod to the culture's originators.

name: Americana Road Movie
summary: Open highways, diners, motel neon and dust; freedom and loneliness in wide screen.
camera: Car-mount shots, wide deserts, dolly along the highway.
light: Golden hour, motel neon, dashboard glow.
editing: Montage of miles; hold the horizon.
movement: Driving, walking the shoulder, dancing at a roadside bar.
design: Pickup trucks, diners, gas stations, boots.

name: Dancehall Yard
summary: Sound systems, yard dances, bright colour and signature steps from the crowd.
camera: Handheld dance circles, low wides of speaker stacks.
light: Sunset, string lights, sound-system glow.
editing: Cut on the riddim accents.
movement: Dancehall steps and crews.
respect: Work with dancers from the scene.

name: Country and Sky
summary: Land as a living presence: red earth, vast sky, family and continuity told from within.
camera: Grounded wides, aerials of country, intimate family close-ups.
light: Hard outback sun, fire at night, star fields.
editing: Patient, respectful pacing.
movement: Walking country, family gatherings.
avoid: Using sacred designs, dot-painting imitation, or depicting deceased people without consent.
respect: Only with First Nations collaborators and community permission.

name: Ocean Voyager
summary: Ocean, canoes, family and song: horizons as home, not the edge of the world.
camera: Water-level shots, drone over reefs, group singing circles.
light: Tropical clarity, sunset gold, starlit navigation.
editing: Swells with the chorus.
movement: Paddling, group song and dance.
avoid: Tiki kitsch; using tattoos (tatau, tā moko) as decoration.
respect: Tattoo designs are personal and sacred; collaborate.

name: Black-and-White Poem
summary: Faces, hands and light in monochrome; every frame a photograph.
camera: Static portraits, slow dollies, shallow focus.
light: Single hard key, deep shadows, window light.
editing: Very few cuts; cut on breath.
movement: Minimal; the smallest gesture matters.

name: One-Take Performance
summary: The whole song as one continuous move around the performer: no cuts, pure presence.
camera: A single unbroken Steadicam or gimbal move that reveals the world as the song builds.
light: Practicals that change as the camera travels.
editing: None; transitions happen inside the shot.
movement: Performer walks and sings to camera through a changing space.

name: Handmade Stop Motion
summary: Felt, clay and paper worlds built by hand; visible fingerprints and charm.
camera: Miniature-scale moves, macro detail.
light: Soft practical light on sets, tiny lamps.
editing: On the beat, playful loops.
movement: Jerky charm, cardboard waves, handmade weather.
respect: Credit the makers.
